A block marker on a continuation line of multiline alt text is escaped

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert

def main() -> None:
    html = '<img alt="Alpha\n-\nBeta" src="image.png">'
    result = convert(html)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
